notes.title: December update
notes.notes:
[h3] Cars with passenger seats [/h3]
Their peculiarity is that they have passenger seats and you can ride with friends in the same car. Also, the open top allows you to see the characters inside this car.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8942802/e8c37f40b4a4493e0be8a0196384e77e4f37401b.png[/img]

[h3] Interactive carousel [/h3]
Carousel for 11 seats. You can sit down and ride on each toy.
[previewyoutube=UKJiHd3M3ko;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3] Lava Knight advantage skin [/h3]
He is bursting with fire that rages in him, glows in the dark!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8942802/6f5fc99afcde5c6ead02b8edec56fc9adc934d42.png[/img]

notes.title: Doctor + bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] - The missing animals were returned. Animations were returned on some of them (chicken and others)
[*] - Some people did not see the purchased flat map.
[*] - In the Steam version it was impossible to rename slots
[*] - Sound settings were not saved in the Steam version
[*] - It was impossible to get out of the trolley through F
[*] - The letter Ё is now written in the chat
[/list]
